name: twice-motion
js: const sec = document.querySelector('#pressed-twice'); const st = () => [sec.className, sec.querySelector('.tw-run-status').textContent.slice(0, 40), sec.querySelectorAll('.tw-log-line').length, sec.querySelectorAll('.tw-wire.is-live').length, sec.querySelector('.tw-shutter').getAttribute('height'), sec.querySelector('.tw-proof').className, sec.querySelector('.tw-proof-rows dd').textContent].join(' | '); const r1 = st(); sec.querySelector('.tw-exec').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const mid = st(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 9000)); return [r1, mid, st()];
